summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload at npm install time
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs detects the installer's platform (with an Alpine/musl branch), downloads Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it (unzip/PowerShell/inline ZIP fallback), chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the tarball-shipped math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB file tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs` — Bun-specific CJS semantics that Node cannot execute or introspect — consisting of a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW` shifting `MmgoCP`), a base32/base64-shaped decoder, and a large char-code constant pool. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern: a language runtime that Node-based scanners cannot follow is fetched at install time solely to execute an opaque bundled payload. The unscoped package name `rwc-client` mirrors the OneReach `@onereach/*` scoped ecosystem (README references onereach.ai; deps include `@onereach/rwc-components`, `@onereach/webform`) but adds an install-time runtime dropper absent from the real vendor distribution — consistent with impersonation of the legitimate OneReach client.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
